systems.system: e-Citizen issue of marriage Registrar's Certificates and Special Licenses
systems.owner: Office of the Registrar of Marriages, Office of the Attorney General
systems.tiers: from 13 January 2026 generated and downloaded only through the portal, ending physical issue at the Registrar's office in Nairobi and other stations; civil, Christian and Hindu marriages

note: Marriages, not births or deaths, and the issue of certificates and licences rather than the making of a register entry.
